name: Fishy
summary: Fishy is a free-to-play social VR fishing game for Meta Quest, developed by ENVER. Built around fishing, friendship and discovery, FISHY lets players cast out together, explore colorful locations, collect an ever-growing variety of fish and upgrade their rods, bait, clothing and gear. Along the way, players can take on challenges, hunt for rare catches, tackle larger-than-life boss encounters and get caught up in unexpected multiplayer moments. Designed as much for hanging out as it is for fishing, FISHY turns a familiar pastime into a shared virtual world built to be explored with friends.
